_comment: Sidecar for cfn-sam-orders.json: a client places an order; the queue hands it to fulfilment.
name: Orders API (SAM)

steps.label: POST /orders
steps.text: The client posts an order to the REST API.
API Gateway invokes the create-order function.
The function writes the order to DynamoDB.
It queues the order for fulfilment.
The queue triggers the fulfilment function.
